subject: ZenWell SOC 2 & Security - Post-call recap and next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference>
To: Asha Patel <asha.patel@zenwell.com>, Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@zenwell.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-06-14T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: ZenWell SOC 2 & Security - Post-call recap and next steps

Hi Asha / Diego,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciate the thorough overview of ZenWell's security requirements and the regulatory scope you're operating under. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Need for SOC 2 Type II evidence (control mappings & latest report) for vendor onboarding.
- Audit log access and retention requirements: 13 months immutable retention for user activity and API logs.
- Data residency: primary US regions, possibility of EU region for PHI/workloads later this year.
- Contractual needs: DPA with specific subprocessor list + standard security addenda.
- Pen test evidence and recent remediation summary for critical CVEs.

Goals we agreed on:
1) Validate that Redwood can provide SOC 2 summary + select evidence (non-sensitive) for your security review.
2) Provide sample audit logs and confirm retention/immutable retention approach.
3) Share DPA draft and the list of subprocessors for legal/procurement review.
4) Deliver pen test evidence stub and remediation timeline for the last two engagements.

What I'm attaching/including in this thread:
- redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf (summary + link to certified report portal)
- audit-logs-sample.csv (redacted sample showing event types + retention metadata)
- dpa-draft-zenwell.pdf (initial DPA draft for your review)
- pen-test-evidence-stub.txt (index of pen test reports and remediation notes)

Next steps / owners:
- Rishi (me): Share attachments (done) and confirm availability for a short security follow-up with your security team (30-45m).
- Marissa (cc'd, Redwood security lead): Standby to field technical questions about logging, KMS, and SOC 2 controls.
- Asha/Diego: Confirm whether the 13-month immutable retention is acceptable or if you need 24 months; also share POC contact for procurement steps.

Proposed follow-up windows: Tuesday 2026-06-16 09:00-11:00 PT or Wednesday 2026-06-17 13:00-15:00 PT. Let me know what works and I'll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to moving this forward.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi — this is helpful. A few clarifying items from our side: 

1) The 13-month immutable retention is our minimum; for some regulated customers we need 24 months. Could you confirm whether Redwood supports configurable retention at customer or workspace level?
2) The SOC 2 summary looks good; can you provide the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA?
3) Procurement wants the DPA redline back within 3 business days. Can you confirm your legal team is available?
4) For pen test evidence, we need confirmation that findings labeled "critical" were remediated and a brief remediation timeline.

We'd like to schedule the security deep-dive on Tuesday 6/16 at 10:00 PT if that works. Please include whoever from your security team can speak to logging retention and KMS key management.

— Asha

Hi Asha / ZenWell team,

Great to meet you on the call this morning. As promised, attaching the one-page remediation summary and the specific audit log fields we expose. Also listing the quick answers here for the record: 

- Immutable retention: configurable per workspace; we can set retention to 24 months and enforce immutability via append-only storage + write-once lifecycle policies.
- Audit logs: We provide event_type, timestamp, actor_id, request_id, resource_path, action, outcome, ip_address, and retention metadata. Sample (redacted) attached: audit-logs-sample.csv.
- SOC 2 report: Full Type II report is available through our secure evidence portal. We require an NDA; instructions will be shared via a protected Doc link.
- Pen test: Critical findings from the recent Q1 2026 test were remediated within 21 days; summary attached in pen-test-evidence-stub.txt. If you need the full third-party report, we can provide it after an NDA and redaction of vendor-sensitive details.

Deliverables (timeline):
- Neha: DPA redline back to ZenWell by 2026-06-18 EOD (legal ops)
- Rishi: Retention configuration doc + secure portal access steps by 2026-06-15 EOD (done / follow-up email will include portal link)
- Marissa: Full remediation summary and pen test index shared in this thread (attached)

Next steps for procurement: once DPA redline is received, procurement can generate an initial SOW / PO. Happy to be looped in for any procurement security questions.

Thanks again — feel free to reach out directly if anything else comes up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
